searchText: Reminder, pectra devnet 4 going down today unless there are any objections raised in the next 3h. hmm, we could use devnet4 to redo the mass topup deposits and see how it reacts. shouldn't take too long why spinning it down? we have mekong with the same spec out, so feels redundant i was hoping to try some attacks on it, but maybe wont even get to it until next week or after devcon so it's prob fine i wish we called it moo deng could attack mekong too https://dora.pectra-devnet-4.ethpandaops.io/slot/0xc486c72e5eba23b0af7220cf53ed74b2487b02cb76da4ee890798e544caf809a looks like lighthouse-erigon-1 proposed a block here with hundreds of deposit transactions, but no deposit requests. it's been orphaned, but looks odd to be even proposed like this again for prysm-erigon-1 & nimbus-erigon-1, so seems to be a erigon issue <@976542403269910539> cc erigon is running `ethpandaops/erigon:pectra_e2-0ff147f` looks like previously of the big deposits, we had lodestar-erigon-1 that was missing slots too The correct head votes clearly dropped since electra activation at epoch 256 on mekong. Aggregates in early electra blocks also look a bit odd: https://dora.mekong.ethpandaops.io/slot/8201 (almost no attestations for the previous slot, but a lot for earlier slots) Seems to recover slowly, but looks a bit suspicious.
